app.sin_resultados_ayuda: Nothing matches the current search or filters.

auth.codigo_2fa_ayuda: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
auth.sin_permiso: Your account does not have access to the admin panel

panel.descripcion: Last {{n}} days · everything you see obeys the selected range
panel.evolucion_ayuda: Revenue and margin per day in the period
panel.top_productos_ayuda: Sorted by margin, not by units sold
panel.def_ingresos: Total collected from paid orders in the period, VAT included.
panel.def_pedidos: Paid orders in the period. Cancelled and refunded ones are excluded.
panel.def_ticket: Revenue divided by number of orders in the period.
panel.def_margen: Revenue excluding VAT minus supplier cost and gateway fees.
panel.tabla_descripcion: Latest orders with status, amount and margin
panel.sin_ventas_ayuda: The first order will show up here.

pedidos.confirmar_cierre: Close this order? It will disappear from the board.
pedidos.confirmar_cierre_detalle: Order {{numero}} moves to history and leaves the board. It can be reopened later.
pedidos.marcar_pagado_ayuda: Only if you know the money arrived. The order will follow the same path as a normal payment: stock is deducted, the supplier is ordered from and the customer is notified.
pedidos.compra_con_fallos: {{n}} purchase(s) failed: check the issues queue
pedidos.compra_pendiente_manual: Still to be bought by hand on the supplier website

kanban.mover_no_permitido: That move is not allowed from this state
kanban.calendario_ayuda: Board orders by the day they came in
kanban.calendario_pie: Each day shows how many orders came in and the amount of the last one. Colour intensifies with the number of orders.

productos.slug_ayuda: Changing it breaks any existing links to this page.
productos.aplicar_peso: Apply to the {{n}} variants without weight
productos.peso_ayuda: An estimate is fine: shipping is recalculated on sync.
productos.plazo_ayuda: Maximum days until delivery. In dropshipping it is usually 15 to 30.
productos.sin_imagenes: This product has no images. Nobody buys what they cannot see.
productos.sin_proveedor: This product does not come from a supplier: it is own stock.
productos.sin_proveedor_ayuda: Imported products show their source cost and availability here.
productos.coste_por_variante: Cost of each variant at the supplier
productos.descatalogado_aviso: The supplier has discontinued {{n}} variant(s). Unpublish before someone buys what cannot be fulfilled.
productos.sin_stock_proveedor: {{n}} variant(s) out of stock at the supplier.
productos.coste_ayuda: Total cost includes the supplier shipping fee: margins計 without it look inflated on cheap products.
productos.actualizar_coste: Ask the supplier for the cost
productos.coste_cambiado: The supplier changed the cost of {{n}} variant(s)
productos.coste_igual: The cost is the same as last time
productos.archivar_ayuda: It disappears from the storefront and search immediately. It is not deleted: existing orders remain valid and you can recover it from the "Archived" filter.
productos.descripcion_corta_ayuda: No HTML: used in listings, in Google and when sharing the link, where tags would be read instead of rendered.
productos.variante_sin_foto: This variant has no image of its own
productos.sin_categorias_ayuda: No categories created yet. Create them under Categories.
productos.marca_ayuda: On import it is filled in from the supplier, when they provide it.
productos.importe_no_valido: That amount cannot be read. Write it as 31.23 or 31,23.
productos.precio_obligatorio: The selling price cannot be left empty.
productos.precio_tachado_ayuda: The price BEFORE the discount. It must be higher than the selling price; leave it empty to remove it.
productos.precio_tachado_sin_anunciar: Saved, but the shop is not advertising a discount: the law requires the compare-at price to be the lowest of the last 30 days.

proveedores.pais_origen_ayuda: Decides the VAT: from outside the EU the sale is an import and the customer may have to pay at customs.
proveedores.descripcion: Where the goods come from. Setup, credentials, margins and where each ships from.
proveedores.sin_proveedores_ayuda: Add the first one to import products and send orders.
proveedores.oauth_explicacion: The App Key and App Secret identify the application, but grant no access to any account. Until the account holder authorises it on AliExpress, nothing can be imported or ordered.
proveedores.oauth_retorno: Callback URL to register in the AliExpress console
proveedores.oauth_por_oauth: Obtained automatically when authorising; nothing to type.
proveedores.oauth_error: The authorisation could not be completed
proveedores.por_identificador_ayuda: Paste the product link or its number. This works even when the supplier does not allow text search.
proveedores.ninguno_listo: No supplier is ready to import from yet.
proveedores.oauth_paso_url: Register this callback URL in the AliExpress console (your app settings). It must match character for character.
proveedores.oauth_paso_boton: Come back here and press “Authorise”. It will take you to AliExpress to sign in and accept.
proveedores.oauth_no_es_ip: This is not the IP allow-list: that lets the server call the API, but grants no access to the account. Both are needed.
proveedores.recargo_compra_ayuda: What the supplier adds at its own checkout and its API never mentions: import charges, destination taxes. AliExpress to Spain measured 26%.
proveedores.cargo_fijo_ayuda: Flat low-value import fee, charged per category. Applies only below {{umbral}} €. When pricing, it is charged in full to each item.
proveedores.catalogo_fichero_ayuda: This supplier has no API: their catalogue arrives as a file and must be uploaded here before you can search or import. Upload it exactly as they send it: the ZIP is accepted as is (.zip), as well as the bare XML (.xml) or a gzipped one (.xml.gz).
proveedores.catalogo_procesando: Processing the catalogue… this may take a while.
proveedores.portes_pedido_ayuda: What the supplier charges for shipping on EACH ORDER, not per item. It is not passed on to the retail price: it is counted once when buying from them.
proveedores.portes_gratis_ayuda: Order value above which the supplier waives shipping. Zero if they always charge it.
proveedores.categorias_creadas: {{n}} categories ready. Imported products now land in the right one.
proveedores.masiva_titulo: Publish the catalogue to the shop
proveedores.masiva_ayuda: Creates or updates every product in the catalogue in one go, each in its category and with its brand, at the price the supplier sets, with no margin added on top. Safe to repeat after each new catalogue: what already exists is updated instead of duplicated.
proveedores.masiva_imagenes_ayuda: Photos are by far the slowest part: without them the import takes minutes, with them it can take over an hour. Unpublished products come in as drafts.
proveedores.masiva_lanzada: Import running. You can close this page: it keeps going in the background.
proveedores.masiva_variantes_nuevas: {{n}} new supplier variants were not created: add them by hand on the product page.
proveedores.masiva_bajo_minimo: {{n}} variants sell below your minimum margin: it is the supplier's price and it stands, but check whether they are worth selling.
proveedores.masiva_actualizar_precios_ayuda: Already imported products move to the supplier's current RRP. That is the norm: it is the price they sell at.
proveedores.masiva_precios_congelados_ayuda: Shop prices stay as they are. Cost, stock, availability and any missing category or brand are still updated. Note: the periodic sync does keep applying the supplier's price.

ajustes.fiscalidad_ayuda: Once EU cross-border sales pass €10,000, those sales carry the customer's country VAT whether or not you are registered for OSS. Registering is what lets you declare it all in one return (form 369).
ajustes.idiomas_ayuda: Only languages that already have translations can be enabled. The default one is what visitors get when they arrive without a language.
ajustes.divisas_ayuda: Charging and invoicing are always in euros; this decides which currency the price is shown in. Requires the “Exchange rate” integration to be active: without it the shop operates in euros only.
ajustes.divisas_sin_proveedor: No exchange rate provider is configured, so there is no currency to offer: the shop shows prices in euros. Enable it under Integrations → Exchange rate.

equipo.nuevo_descripcion: Create a staff account and decide what it can access.
equipo.email_ayuda: The invitation to set a password is sent to this address.
equipo.creado_ayuda: They cannot sign in yet: they need to set a password with the token below.
equipo.invitacion_ayuda: This is what they use to set a password. It is shown here because email delivery can fail; if the email arrives, there is no need to pass it on by hand.
equipo.copiar_error: Could not copy. Select it manually.
equipo.roles_ayuda: Permissions are granted through roles, not one by one.
equipo.sin_roles_ayuda: Without roles nobody can be added: there would be nothing to assign.
equipo.permisos_efectivos: What they will be able to do
equipo.permisos_ayuda: The sum of all their roles, which is what is actually granted.
equipo.permisos_vacio: With no role selected they will have no access to the panel.
equipo.eres_tu_ayuda: If you remove your own access it stops working on the next request: the screen you are on may fail to load.
equipo.estado_ayuda: A deactivated account cannot sign in and all its sessions are closed.
equipo.sesiones_ayuda: What is open right now, and from where.
equipo.cerrar_sesiones_aviso: All of {{nombre}}’s sessions will be closed and they must sign in again.

envios.descripcion: Zones and rates. What each order is charged comes from here.
envios.sin_zonas_ayuda: Without zones configured no order can be completed.
envios.zona_sin_tarifas: This zone has no rates: nothing can ship to it.
envios.gratis_desde_ayuda: Empty = never free. Compared against the subtotal, excluding shipping.
envios.confirmar_borrado: Delete “{{nombre}}”? If it is the zone's only rate, nothing can ship there.

devoluciones.descripcion: Returns and withdrawals. Refunds have a 14-day legal deadline.
devoluciones.estado_recibido: What condition did it arrive in?
devoluciones.estado_recibido_ayuda: Only “new” and “perfect” go back to stock. A defective product never does.
devoluciones.importe_ayuda: Maximum {{maximo}}, the value of what was returned.
devoluciones.motivo_rechazo_ayuda: Required: it is what the customer is told and what is shown if they complain.

clientes.rgpd_ayuda: You have one month to answer an access or erasure request from the day the customer makes it.
clientes.anonimizar_aviso: Personal data is erased but invoices are kept, as legally required. This cannot be undone.

auditoria.descripcion: Who did what and with which values. Read-only.
auditoria.sin_registros_ayuda: Changes made by the team from the panel show up here.

categorias.descripcion: The tree customers browse. Marking +18 cascades to the whole branch.
categorias.sin_categorias_ayuda: Without categories, products appear in no section of the shop.
categorias.es_adulto_aviso: Everything under it will be restricted and require age verification.
categorias.confirmar_con_productos: “{{nombre}}” has {{n}} products. Deleting it removes them from the shop.
categorias.atributos_ayuda: These are the facets customers filter by in listings.

cupones.sin_cupones_ayuda: Create one to launch a promotion.
cupones.nota_ayuda: For the team; customers do not see it
cupones.aviso_sin_tope: A {{valor}}% with no cap can give away a lot of margin on a large order.

referidos.descripcion: Existing customers recommend the shop and both get a discount when the referred person places their first order.
referidos.canjeado_ayuda: What it actually cost: a coupon that expires unused costs nothing.
referidos.activo_ayuda: While it is off no coupon is issued, although invitations are still recorded.
referidos.aviso_ruinoso: Both rewards together reach the minimum order: the programme would lose money on every referral.
referidos.sin_datos_ayuda: They will show up here as soon as someone orders using an invitation code.

experimentos.descripcion: Try two versions of a piece of copy, a shipping price or a layout and keep the one that sells more.
experimentos.hipotesis_ejemplo: E.g. "Buy now" converts better than "Add to basket"
experimentos.reparto_ayuda: Use 10 to roll out a risky change gradually.
experimentos.confirmar_sin_datos: There is not enough evidence yet to say this variant wins. Close the experiment anyway?
experimentos.sin_datos_ayuda: Create one to compare two versions of something and keep the one that sells more.

canales.descripcion: Google Ads and Meta Ads do not allow adult catalogues. Here is what is left: where sales come from and who to pay for bringing them.
canales.sin_ventas_ayuda: As soon as the first order comes in you will see which channel it came from.
canales.constructor_ayuda: A misspelled utm_source raises no error: it just keeps the campaign out of the report and makes it look like it did not work.
canales.comision_ayuda: Calculated on the lines excluding VAT and shipping, after coupons. It accrues on payment and is approved once the return window closes.
canales.comision_alta: A commission this size eats a large part of the margin. Check it before saving.
canales.sin_afiliados_ayuda: It is the channel that works best with a restricted catalogue: whoever recommends already has the audience.

informes.descripcion: What you invoice and what you actually keep.
informes.iva_ayuda: not revenue, it is collected for the tax office
informes.productos_ayuda: Sorted by what they contribute, not by units: the best seller is not always the best earner.
informes.sin_productos: No product sales in this period.
informes.csv_ayuda: Ready to open in Spanish Excel, with semicolons and comma decimals.
informes.oss_ayuda: What goes in the quarterly OSS return and how far you are from having to charge the customer's country VAT.
informes.oss_superado: Threshold passed: sales to other EU countries carry the customer's country VAT.
informes.oss_alta_pendiente: OSS registration is missing. Sales are already taxable in the destination country, so the VAT charged cannot be declared through the One-Stop Shop until you register.
informes.oss_vacio: Nothing to declare for this quarter.
informes.recuperacion_ayuda: Of the baskets we emailed, how many turned into orders.

metodos_pago.descripcion: Which payment options customers see, in what order and for which amounts.
metodos_pago.credenciales_aviso: Each gateway's keys are configured in Settings → Integrations, encrypted and never shown again. This screen decides what is offered at checkout, in which order and for which amounts.
metodos_pago.sin_operativas: No payment method is currently operational.
metodos_pago.sin_operativas_ayuda: The shop still shows products, but nobody can complete a purchase. Usually the server is missing the credentials.
metodos_pago.rango_aviso: Only offered on orders from {{min}} € to {{max}} €.

portada.descripcion: The sections visitors see, in the order they see them. Changes take up to five minutes to show up in the shop.
portada.oscurecer: Darken the image so the text stays readable
portada.categorias_ayuda: With none ticked, the top-level categories are shown.

menu.descripcion: The links in the bar below the header, on every page.
menu.vacio: With no links the bar is not shown. Add the first one below.
menu.campo_url_ayuda: A shop path (“/buscar”) or a full address (“https://…”).
menu.campo_etiqueta_ayuda: Leave it empty to use the real name, already translated.
menu.campo_etiqueta_obligatoria: Required: an address has no name to take it from.
menu.maximo: Maximum {{n}}: a longer bar cannot be read.
menu.campo_pagina_ayuda: Published pages only. Unpublish it and the link leaves the menu.
menu.campo_categoria_ayuda: Goes to the catalogue filtered by that category.
menu.categoria_vacia: This category has no published products anywhere in its branch, so the shop will not show it: a link to an empty listing gets clicked once and never again. Publish products in it or pick another one.

paginas.descripcion: The shop's legal texts and standalone pages, by language.
paginas.vacio_ayuda: The ones Spain requires are created on install; if they are missing, run the seed.
paginas.aviso_sin_publicar: {{n}} required pages are still drafts. Until you publish them the shop shows them empty, and Spanish law requires the legal notice and privacy policy to be reachable.
paginas.editor_descripcion: One language at a time. The ones still unwritten carry a dot.
paginas.campo_handle_ayuda: Internal name, lowercase with hyphens. Never shown in the shop.
paginas.campo_handle_bloqueado: Locked: the installer finds this page by its identifier and the shop footer links to it by that name.
paginas.campo_estado_ayuda: Drafts are not visible in the shop. Publishing requires content in every language that has a title.
paginas.campo_slug_sistema: Change it only if you know what you are doing: the shop footer links these pages by their original address.
paginas.campo_content_ayuda: Plain text. Line breaks are kept; HTML tags would be shown literally.
paginas.campo_metatitle_ayuda: Up to 70 characters. Left empty, the title is used.
paginas.error_handle: The identifier only accepts lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
paginas.error_sin_idioma: At least one language needs a title and an address.
paginas.error_slug: Invalid address in {{idiomas}}: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
paginas.error_a_medias: No title or no address in {{idiomas}}: that language would not be saved.
paginas.error_contenido: Cannot publish with the content nearly empty in {{idiomas}}.
paginas.borrar_descripcion: It will disappear from the shop and from the menu. Any link pointing to it will stop working.

traducciones.descripcion: Machine translation proposals. None of this is live until you approve it.
traducciones.sin_motor: No translator configured, so no new translations are produced. Enable it with TRANSLATION_PROVIDER on the server.
traducciones.vacio_ayuda: Translated product pages show up here when you import from a supplier.

integraciones.descripcion: External services the shop uses. Anything not configured and active is neither loaded nor offered to customers.
integraciones.familia_pago_ayuda: How customers can pay. With none operative, no purchase can be completed.
integraciones.familia_correo_ayuda: Order confirmations and dispatch notices go out through here.
integraciones.familia_traduccion_ayuda: Translates imported product pages; proposals are reviewed before going live.
integraciones.familia_acceso_ayuda: "Sign in with" buttons. Not configured means not shown.
integraciones.url_oauth_ayuda: Paste it into the provider console, under “Authorised redirect URIs”. Without it, sign-in fails even with the right keys.
integraciones.url_ipn_ayuda: Paste it into the gateway dashboard, in the IPN or callback field. Without it the customer pays and nobody tells us: the order waits forever for a payment already made.
integraciones.url_webhook_ayuda: Paste it into the service dashboard, where webhooks are registered. Without it the customer pays and nobody tells us: the order waits forever for a payment already made.
integraciones.familia_almacenamiento_ayuda: Where product photos live. Without it, images cannot be imported or uploaded.
integraciones.familia_buscador_ayuda: Text search and autocomplete. Without it the shop still sells by category.
integraciones.familia_imagenes_ayuda: Cutouts, clean backgrounds and scenes. Needs your own or a rented GPU.
integraciones.familia_seguimiento_ayuda: Looks up where each parcel is by its number. Without it the customer still gets their link, but the order will not move to «in transit» or «delivered» on its own.
integraciones.familia_analitica_ayuda: Visit and conversion measurement. Only loaded if the visitor has accepted the matching cookies.

riesgo.descripcion: Paid but not sent to the supplier until someone reviews them. Releasing a good one takes a click; letting fraud through costs the goods.
riesgo.ninguno_ayuda: Everything that came in passed the risk check.

ui.atajo_paleta: Press ⌘K to search the whole panel

avisos.nada_ayuda: No stuck orders, failed queues or unanswered returns.
avisos.fallo: Could not check the current operational state.
avisos.pagina_ayuda: Everything that is stuck right now, grouped by where it gets fixed
avisos.incidencias: {{n}} paid order(s) never purchased from the supplier

estados.sin_permiso: You do not have access to this block
estados.sin_permiso_ayuda: Ask whoever administers the panel to grant you the required permission.

filtros.rango_invalido: The start date cannot be later than the end date.

kpi.sin_base: no data in the previous period

perfil.descripcion: Your details, your password and where your session is open
perfil.password_ayuda: At least 12 characters. Longer is better.
perfil.password_no_coincide: The two passwords do not match.
perfil.password_cierra_sesiones: Changing it closes every other open session.
perfil.dos_pasos_ayuda: Adds a one-time code at sign-in. Required for roles with admin permissions.
perfil.dos_pasos_activo_ayuda: Disabling it requires your password and a valid code.
perfil.escanea: Scan the code with your authenticator app and type the six-digit code.
perfil.qr_alt: QR code for the authenticator app
perfil.codigos_ayuda: They are shown only once. They are how you get in if you lose your phone.
perfil.sesiones_ayuda: Every device you have signed in from. If you see something you do not recognise, close them all and change your password.
perfil.cerrar_todas_ayuda: This also closes the session you are working in now and you will have to sign in again.

403.titulo: You do not have permission to see this
403.ayuda: Your role does not include the permission this screen needs. If you need it to work, ask whoever administers the panel.

404.ayuda: The address does not match any screen in the panel. The link may be old or the section may have moved.

500.ayuda: The error has been logged. You can retry without losing your session; if it happens again, report the id below.

imagenes.recortar_ayuda: Drag to choose the framing. The crop is saved as a new image.
imagenes.subir_ayuda: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF. Optimised on upload.
imagenes.ayuda_principal: The first image is the one shown in listings and when sharing the link.
imagenes.borrar_ayuda: It is removed from the product and the store. This cannot be undone.
imagenes.recorte_fallo: The browser would not read the cropped image. This is usually a permissions issue on the image storage.

incidencias.descripcion: Paid orders that were never purchased from the supplier. Each one is a customer who has already paid and is still waiting.
incidencias.ninguna_ayuda: Everything charged has been purchased from the supplier.
incidencias.referencia_ayuda: The one the supplier gave you when you bought it. With it the parcel can be tracked; without it, the order counts as bought with no way to check.
incidencias.compras_manuales: Purchases waiting to be placed by hand
incidencias.compras_manuales_ayuda: Suppliers without an API: the order is paid and must be bought on their website. Copy the code, buy it and record their order reference here.
incidencias.sin_stock_proveedor: out of stock at the supplier
incidencias.envios_parados_ayuda: Parcels that have not moved for weeks. They are usually lost: getting ahead of it and reshipping or refunding costs less than a dispute.

editor.ayuda: The storefront only renders these tags; the rest is stripped on save:

margenes.explicacion: What is selling below the margin you want. Margin is measured against what you actually earn: the shelf price includes VAT, and that money belongs to the tax office, not to you. Cost is the supplier’s, shipping included.
margenes.en_perdidas: {{count}} variant is selling below its cost.
margenes.en_perdidas_plural: {{count}} variants are selling below their cost.
margenes.ingreso_ayuda: What is left of the price once VAT is deducted. That is what gets compared with the cost.

marcas.descripcion: Manufacturers of the products. They are created on import; here you add a logo and fix names.
marcas.ninguna_ayuda: They are created automatically when importing products from a supplier that declares the manufacturer.
marcas.logo_error: The logo could not be uploaded
marcas.eliminar_confirmar: «{{nombre}}» will be deleted. It has no products, so nothing else is lost.

studio.campanas_descripcion: Marketing material is made here, always inside a campaign: that way you know what each piece was for and which one actually sold.
studio.biblioteca_descripcion: Images used to build the pieces. Each one records where it came from.
studio.sin_campanas_ayuda: A campaign groups the pieces, the tracking and the spend. Start there and the creatives hang off it.
studio.sin_creatividades: This campaign has no pieces yet
studio.sin_creatividades_ayuda: Pick a format and design it. You can adapt it to the other sizes later without redoing it.
studio.sin_activos_ayuda: Upload photos, backgrounds or logos to use in your pieces.
studio.retirar_activo_ayuda: “{{nombre}}” will no longer be offered while designing. Pieces already using it are untouched: the file is not deleted.
studio.sin_destino: This campaign has no destination address, so its pieces cannot carry a tracked link and their sales cannot be attributed.
studio.campo_nombre_creatividad_ayuda: It shows up in the link tracking, so make it recognisable in a report.
studio.campo_destino_ayuda: Where the ad leads. Each piece's tracked link is built from this.
studio.campo_brief_ayuda: What you want to achieve and for whom. If the assistant is ever switched on, this is the context it reads.
studio.formatos_todos_puestos: Every format from this network is already in the document.
studio.sin_capas: No layers yet. Add text, a shape or an image with the buttons above.
studio.nada_seleccionado: Pick a layer on the canvas or in the list to see its properties.
studio.reabierta: The piece is back to draft: what's live is the exported file, and the document no longer matches it.
studio.versiones_ayuda: Restoring a version copies it as a new one: the path you took is not lost.
studio.export_pesa: Exported, but it weighs {{peso}} and the format allows {{maximo}}. Try JPG or lighten the images.
studio.prop_ajuste_texto_ayuda: “Shrink” keeps a longer headline in another language from spilling out of the banner.
studio.importar_html_ayuda: Upload a file or paste the markup. You can bring it in broken into editable layers, or as one piece.
studio.importar_capas_ayuda: The browser lays it out and every element becomes a layer you can move and rewrite. Fluid layout is lost: what was flexible gets a fixed position, which is what a banner wants anyway.
studio.importar_bloque_ayuda: Comes in whole and you edit the code. Keeps animations and behaviour, but nothing can be dragged separately.
studio.importar_vacio: Nothing visible was found within the artboard size. Check that the HTML paints something at this size.
studio.importar_imagenes_one: 1 image points outside: upload it to the library and assign it to its layer.
studio.importar_imagenes_other: {{count}} images point outside: upload them to the library and assign them to their layers.
studio.prop_css_ayuda: Applies only inside this layer, so it can't repaint the rest of the admin.
studio.enlace_no_copiado: The browser wouldn't let us copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
studio.a_medida_ayuda: With no network format behind it there is no maximum weight to check on export.
studio.codigo_html_ayuda: The piece's HTML exactly as it is painted and exported. Copy it, or edit it and apply.
studio.codigo_rehace: Applying rebuilds the layers from the code: position and styles are kept, the names you gave them and the link to library assets are lost.
studio.codigo_vacio: The code paints nothing within the artboard size.
studio.campo_estado_ayuda: A campaign starts as a draft. Set it to active when it goes live.
